parent_objective: audit targeted midcourse corridor-containment config materialization before any training execution design
blocked_by: M2259 materialization must be audited before execution design

public_gates: M2260 must audit M2259 result_class and artifact completeness
M2260 must verify 15 configs and 15 matrix rows with one budget signature
M2260 must verify target repair values match M2258
M2260 must verify actor contract and track_width guardrails are clean
M2260 must select training-execution design, materialization repair, synthesis, or stop
M2260 must not run reset rollout measured execution training replay PPO private holdout ranking or paper/self-ID claims
forbidden_shortcuts: do not change actor observation contract
do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits whether the targeted config matrix is execution-admissible without expanding claims
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: config materialization audit only; no rollout ranking paper finite-window-vs-GRU or self-ID claim
stop_condition: stop if target values mismatch M2258
stop if contract or track_width guardrails fail
stop if materialization started training or rollout
fallback_plan: route to training-execution design if materialization is clean
route to materialization repair if artifacts or values are wrong
route to synthesis or stop if execution is not defensible
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M2259 completed targeted containment config materialization

training_stage.stage_objective: audit M2259 targeted containment config materialization
allowed_updates: M2260 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up execution-design repair synthesis or stop manifest
next_stage_criteria: M2259 completeness and guardrails are audited

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2260 audits config artifacts and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: None in M2260; no wrong-history reset-hidden or zero-history intervention is run.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If materialization is flawed, repair configs rather than lowering paper/self-ID standards.
allowed_claims: no controller ranking paper-level result finite-window-vs-GRU conclusion or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: decides whether targeted containment configs can advance to execution design

failure_criteria: M2260 starts reset rollout measured execution training replay PPO or private holdout
